scope: First interleaved model RGB-D and constructed virtual-camera rendering attempt
summary: The first 110-frame/55-view artifact completed and passed nominal metrics, but NumPy matmul emitted divide-by-zero, overflow, and invalid RuntimeWarnings, so the run was not accepted as the final numerical result.
evidence: The warnings originated at the finite 4xN camera transform matmul on NumPy 2.2.6/Apple Accelerate and reproduced under -W error.
A direct np.dot of the same finite operands produced finite results without warnings; v1 artifacts remain preserved.
lessons: A passing metric report is insufficient when the numerical path emits runtime warnings on real resolution data.
limitations: v1 cannot be the accepted implementation evidence despite its nominal proposal metrics.
next_actions: Use the warning-free explicit dot transform, add a full 280x504 regression, enforce RuntimeWarning=error, and rerun in a new directory.
